name: compass
description: A workbench and methodology that connects Codebase-Cartographer, ClauDHD, and Gantry into one idea-to-implementation pipeline. The map feeds the plan, the plan registers on the roadmap, the roadmap is what the cursor points at, and the cursor advances when a phase ships. Adds the connective commands and a two-lane triage; the three instruments keep owning their files.
